name: nook
author: achevalier-dev
description: Your Raspberry Pi in the Omarchy bar: reachable anywhere, a shared folder, and a network drive that mounts like a USB stick.

barWidget.description: Shows whether your nook is reachable and whether its drive is attached here. The panel carries temperature, disk use, containers, and the mount and attach actions.

schema.label: Refresh interval
schema.description: How often to ask the nook how it is doing. Each check is one SSH round trip over a reused connection.

schema.label: Temperature warning
schema.description: Colour the glyph when the CPU goes above this many degrees.
